property: RFC 1157 formally obsoletes RFC 1098 and becomes the canonical SNMPv1 protocol specification generation

sources.supports: RFC 1157 explicitly obsoletes RFC 1098 and preserves the SNMP architecture centered on management stations, agents, managed variables and simple operations.

negative_claims: This edge does not imply that RFC 1157 alone defines the entire SNMPv1 framework; SMI and MIB documents are separate artifacts.
open_questions: Build exact RFC 1098 to RFC 1157 content diff and connect related SMI/MIB revision records.
